tools.name: CRISPRidentify
tools.description: Detect CRISPR arrays and score candidates.

cli_modes.name: crispridentify (direct flags)
cli_modes.description: Detect arrays in each submitted DNA record.

flags.label: Fast search
flags.description: Uses the shipped fast search; disabling it runs the historical full search.

flags.label: Fast-search seed profile
flags.description: Selects the fast search seed/gap profile: balanced, historical legacy, or sensitive normal-mode seeds. Requires fast search.

flags.label: Degenerated repeat search
flags.description: Searches for degenerated or terminal repeats at candidate array ends.

flags.label: Minimum repeat length
flags.description: Minimum average candidate repeat length in bases.

flags.label: Maximum repeat length
flags.description: Maximum average candidate repeat length in bases.

flags.label: Minimum spacer length
flags.description: Minimum average candidate spacer length in bases.

flags.label: Maximum spacer length
flags.description: Maximum average candidate spacer length in bases.

flags.label: Minimum repeat count
flags.description: Minimum repeats required in a candidate array. Two-repeat candidates need cautious interpretation.

managed.description: Inputs and canonical outputs are assigned by the job worker.
CPU allocation and concurrent lanes follow the service resource budget.
The workflow controls orientation annotation and any optional Cas or IS-element stages.

tools.name: CasAndra
tools.description: Call genes from DNA, identify Cas proteins and classify cassettes.

cli_modes.name: predict-genome
cli_modes.description: The web workflow calls genes and classifies Cas cassettes from DNA.

cli_modes.name: predict-proteins / annotate-proteins / classify-cassette
cli_modes.description: Standalone protein classification, provenance-bound protein annotation, or classification of an ordered protein cassette.

cli_modes.name: inspect-model
cli_modes.description: Operator verification and inspection of a frozen model bundle.

flags.label: Gene calling mode
flags.description: Auto selects a gene-calling mode from sequence length; single trains on a genome, and meta uses metagenomic models.

managed.description: The job supplies DNA and output locations; the model bundle is provisioned by the operator.
The requested code affects single-genome training or supplied GFF3 translation; metagenomic calling selects codes per gene. The web workflow leaves this at its shipped default.

tools.name: CRISPRtracrRNA
tools.description: Screen covariance models or run the complete locus workflow.

cli_modes.name: run --mode model
cli_modes.description: tracrRNA screening runs covariance models on submitted DNA.

cli_modes.name: run --mode complete
cli_modes.description: Locus annotation combines internal array detection, gene calls, anti-repeat matching and covariance evidence.

cli_modes.name: doctor
cli_modes.description: Operator inspection of scientific runtime dependencies.

flags.label: Covariance-model rescue
flags.description: Adds supported covariance-model candidates to the complete workflow; disabling it retains the anti-repeat route.

flags.label: Model-rescue E-value
flags.description: Maximum E-value for covariance-model rescue evidence; lower values are more stringent.

flags.label: Internal array search
flags.description: Selects the shipped array-detection preset used internally by the complete tracrRNA workflow.

flags.label: Internal gene calling
flags.description: Chooses automatic, single-genome or metagenomic gene calling in the complete tracrRNA workflow.

flags.label: Anti-repeat identity
flags.description: Minimum identity fraction for anti-repeat matches.

flags.label: Anti-repeat coverage
flags.description: Minimum covered fraction for anti-repeat matches.

flags.label: Candidate tail length
flags.description: Bases retained after an anti-repeat match when constructing RNA candidates.

flags.label: Candidate upstream length
flags.description: Bases retained upstream of an anti-repeat match.

flags.label: Candidate merge gap
flags.description: Maximum genomic gap for merging covariance-model hits in model-only screening.

managed.description: Type II / V-K is selected in the workflow options below.
The worker owns execution limits, paths and the installed search backend.

tools.name: SpacerPlacer
tools.description: Reconstruct ancestral spacer arrays and compare deletion models.

cli_modes.name: --input_type ccdb
cli_modes.description: Uses source-verified CRISPRCasDB-style array groups prepared from detected arrays.

flags.label: Random seed
flags.description: Seeds MAFFT alignment and the random spacer encoding used for large groups; changing it can change the alignment.

flags.label: Tree construction
flags.description: Chooses UPGMA or neighbor joining when estimating the tree from spacer arrays.

flags.label: Reconstruction insertion rate
flags.description: Sets the insertion rate in the ancestral reconstruction model.

flags.label: Reconstruction deletion rate
flags.description: Sets the deletion rate in the ancestral reconstruction model.

flags.label: Branch extension
flags.description: Adds length to branches before ancestral reconstruction; zero leaves lengths unchanged.

flags.label: Model comparison significance
flags.description: Changes the likelihood-ratio-test cutoff for preferring the block deletion model.

managed.description: The workflow supplies source-verified array groups and estimates a tree; uploaded trees are not supported.
Spacer matching and bias requests are set in workflow options; operator safety policy can disable bias corrections.
Concurrency and new output directories are managed; unsafe pickle input is unavailable.

tools.name: evOr
tools.description: Compare array orientations and reconstruct the selected orientation.

cli_modes.name: crispr-evor --input_type ccdb
cli_modes.description: Uses source-verified CRISPRCasDB-style array groups; the evOr command always enables forward/reverse comparison.

flags.label: Random seed
flags.description: Seeds MAFFT alignment and the random spacer encoding used for large groups; changing it can change the alignment.

flags.label: Tree construction
flags.description: Chooses UPGMA or neighbor joining when estimating the tree from spacer arrays.

flags.label: Reconstruction insertion rate
flags.description: Sets the insertion rate in the ancestral reconstruction model.

flags.label: Reconstruction deletion rate
flags.description: Sets the deletion rate in the ancestral reconstruction model.

flags.label: Branch extension
flags.description: Adds length to branches before ancestral reconstruction; zero leaves lengths unchanged.

flags.label: Model comparison significance
flags.description: Changes the likelihood-ratio-test cutoff for preferring the block deletion model.

flags.label: Orientation decision boundary
flags.description: Minimum absolute forward/reverse log-likelihood difference for an orientation call; higher values leave more orientations undetermined.

managed.description: Enabled by the orientation workflow.
Spacer matching and bias requests are set in workflow options.
Execution resources, estimated trees and new outputs follow the worker policy.

tools.name: CRISPRleader
tools.description: Extract both flanks of detected arrays, with source coordinates.

cli_modes.name: extract
cli_modes.description: Extract adjacent genomic windows; these are not predicted leader boundaries.

cli_modes.name: predict
cli_modes.description: Unavailable in the pinned release: biological references, inference policy and evaluation are incomplete.

managed.description: Adjust the flank length in workflow options below.
Source-verified arrays and output locations come from the workflow.

tools.name: CRISPRrepeat
tools.description: Fold supplied repeats or compare isolated repeat folds with local array context.

cli_modes.name: crisprrepeat (without --reports)
cli_modes.description: Fold each submitted repeat; DNA evaluates both orientations and transcribed RNA uses forward only.

cli_modes.name: crisprrepeat --reports
cli_modes.description: Uses canonical detected-array reports with the original genome to evaluate repeat instances in local context.

flags.label: Folding temperature (°C)
flags.description: Changes the ViennaRNA thermodynamic model temperature for all folds.

flags.label: Exclude lonely pairs
flags.description: Excludes isolated base pairs from the folding model.

flags.label: Local window length
flags.description: Maximum local folding window in bases. Short contexts use their own length.

flags.label: Maximum pairing span
flags.description: Maximum local base-pair span, including endpoints; must not exceed the window.

managed.description: DNA / RNA is selected next to the repeat input.
Both DNA orientations are retained; transcribed RNA uses forward orientation.
The workflow binds source records, reports, categories, output locations and execution limits.

tools.name: CRISPRmap
tools.description: Map repeats against a frozen annotated reference.

cli_modes.name: classify
cli_modes.description: Search both orientations for the nearest reference matches.

cli_modes.name: build-reference / inspect-reference
cli_modes.description: Reference creation and verification are operator tasks.

flags.label: Maximum edit distance
flags.description: Maximum global substitutions, insertions and deletions; zero restricts results to exact matches.

flags.label: Displayed reference hits
flags.description: Caps displayed nearest ties per repeat. All nearest ties still determine annotation evidence.

managed.description: The worker supplies the pinned reference and job files.
Comparison and execution budgets are managed by the service.

tools.name: CRISPRspacer
tools.description: Search an immutable observed-spacer collection or a viral reference.

cli_modes.name: database-search
cli_modes.description: Match submitted target DNA against observed spacers using exact full-length matches.

cli_modes.name: viral-search
cli_modes.description: Search supplied spacers against the frozen viral BLAST reference, then filter full-query matches.

managed.description: Viral search allows 0–2 substitutions, selected beside search direction. This flag does not exist in database-search.
References and their digests are pinned by the operator.
Paths, executable choice and bounded work limits are owned by the worker.

tools.name: RepeatTyper
tools.description: Predict repeat-derived subtype evidence using the preserved 37-class model.

cli_modes.name: repeattyper classify
cli_modes.description: Classify supplied repeat occurrences offline.

flags.label: Minimum model score
flags.description: Below this score, retain the winner but leave the prediction unknown. Scores are not calibrated confidence.

tools.name: SpacePHARER
tools.description: Combine translated and nucleotide spacer evidence within explicit groups against an immutable targeted panel.

cli_modes.name: spacepharer associate
cli_modes.description: Evaluate explicit spacer group associations offline.

flags.label: Maximum empirical FDR
flags.description: Applied only when the native target/control distribution supports calibration. Uncalibrated candidates remain unaccepted.

managed.label: Worker-managed input, panel and resource budget

tools.name: CCTK
tools.description: Compare observed ordered spacer occurrences and exact sharing networks.

cli_modes.name: cctk compare
cli_modes.description: Compare complete observed spacer lists; no evolutionary inference.

flags.label: DNA equality
flags.description: Reverse-complement equality changes matching only; it never infers strand or acquisition order.

flags.label: Minimum shared spacers
flags.description: Apply this distinct-spacer threshold to both edges and connected components.

managed.label: Worker-managed inputs, order, plot and output
